279.name: M2 locator enhancement mock
279.description: M2 mock case for table context, overlay scoping, and custom select input.

steps.description: Click Beta row Run button via table context

280.name: M2 ambiguous locator mock
280.description: M2 mock case that should fail with LOCATOR_AMBIGUOUS.

281.name: M5 advanced capability mock
281.description: M5 mock case for iframe locator context, file upload, download assertion, and JSON/API assertion.

282.name: M5-B advanced capability mock
282.description: M5-B mock case for Monaco-like editor input, tree semantic locator, and popup page switching.

steps.description: Open popup page and switch active page

283.name: M5-C export and network mock
283.description: M5-C mock case for network mock and API JSON assertion with POST body.

284.name: M5-F request assertion mock
284.description: M5-F mock case for asserting outbound request URL, method, and body.

steps.description: Assert audit POST request while clicking send button

285.name: M5-G network delay and request count mock
285.description: M5-G mock case for delayed network mock and request count assertion.

steps.description: Assert exactly two ping POST requests

286.name: M5-H response assertion and abort mock
286.description: M5-H mock case for response body assertion and network abort failure injection.

steps.description: Assert health response JSON while clicking fetch button
Assert aborted request handled by page

287.name: M5-I response snapshot mock
287.description: M5-I mock case for saving response body and metadata snapshots.

steps.description: Assert profile response and save snapshot

288.name: M5-J response baseline mock
288.description: M5-J mock case for comparing response body against a baseline file.

steps.description: Assert profile response matches baseline and save snapshot

289.name: M5-K network replay mock
289.description: M5-K mock case for replaying multiple network responses from a fixture file.

steps.description: Assert both replayed requests were sent

290.name: M5-L advanced upload and download mock
290.description: M5-L mock case for multi-file upload and advanced download assertions.

steps.description: Assert advanced download metadata and hash

291.name: M5-N multi-window switching mock
291.description: M5-N mock case for switching between main and popup pages, then closing popup and returning to main page.

steps.description: Open popup page and switch active page
Assert main page is active again
Switch to popup by URL substring
Click popup action after explicit switch
Close popup and return to main page
Assert main page remains active after popup close

292.name: M5-O multi-popup disambiguation mock
292.description: M5-O mock case for opening two popups and selecting the intended page by title and URL.

steps.description: Return to main page before opening another popup
Switch to Alpha popup by title
Switch to Beta popup by URL
Close Beta and fallback to Alpha
Assert Alpha remains active after Beta close
Close Alpha and return to main
Assert main page active after closing popups

293.name: M5-O advanced tree mock
293.description: M5-O mock case for expandable tree and checkbox tree item selection.

steps.description: Click Ops Alerts checkbox tree node semantically
Assert checkbox tree node changed state

294.name: M5-O Monaco shortcut mock
294.description: M5-O mock case for multiline Monaco-like input and keyboard shortcut handling.

295.name: M5-O hidden upload and binary download mock
295.description: M5-O mock case for proxy hidden file input and binary download metadata assertion.

steps.description: Upload through hidden input proxy button
Assert binary download metadata and hash

296.name: M5-O export e2e smoke mock
296.description: M5-O mock case used to execute exported Playwright script end to end.

steps.description: Input username for export e2e smoke
Submit form in export e2e smoke

297.name: Locator semantic hidden checkbox mock
297.description: CDP and Playwright Runner parity case for a hidden native checkbox with a visible component wrapper.

steps.description: Click hidden native checkbox through its visible component wrapper
